1947 is not a leap year (1947 % 4 = 3).  
126 days before May 29, 1947:  
April has 30 days, so back to April 29 is 30 days (May 29 → April 29).  
126 - 30 = 96 days earlier from April 29.  
March has 31 days → back to March 29 is 31 days (96 - 31 = 65).  
February has 28 days → back to Feb 28 is 28 days (65 - 28 = 37).  
January has 31 days → back to Jan 28 is 31 days (37 - 31 = 6).  
Jan 28 minus 6 days = Jan 22, 1947.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1947-01-22
